meaning: The person's new message starts a genuinely unrelated task: a different incident, a different deliverable, nothing left in common with what came before in this conversation. A follow-up, a correction, a narrowing, a test of the same work, a write-up or publication of the work just done, or a natural next step of the same work is not this, however abruptly it is phrased.
match: forget that for now. my laptop won't connect to the office wifi, help me debug that
different thing: the billing export job has been failing since Tuesday, can you look
ok that's done. now I need a script that pulls all my icloud photos onto this machine
park it. I have a talk on Thursday and I need slides for it
new task, unrelated: write me a bash one-liner that renames every file in a folder to lowercase
not_match: now write a test for it
write that up as a PR description
why does that function take the path twice?
hold on, that broke the other case, go back to what you had
same thing but for the cursor wrapper too
on_hit: offscope-session: this prompt starts work with nothing left in common with the work so far. Suggest a /clear or a fresh session before starting it, so the finished work's context stops being re-sent (and paid for) on every later turn. Suggest the reset; do not enforce it.
